summary: Comprehensive frontend-only testing (offline Expo web preview, mobile viewport 390x844). All 9 critical user flows passed end-to-end: Setup Wizard (name/cash/BBCA add/finish) → Dashboard shows Rp 14.800.000 NW (10 lot x 100 x 9800 + 5M cash) matching expected; Reload persistence works (wizard skipped, NW preserved); Dashboard Bulanan/Tahunan toggle present (testIDs networth-mode-month / -year); BTC Cycle banner shows 'ZONA AKUMULASI AGRESIF / BEST DCA' for Oct 2026; Audit accordion toggles and 'Tambah Aset Baru' flow adds USD QQQ (2x450x15500 = Rp 13.950.000 ✓); Merging same ticker (QQQ) uses WAC and increases qty to 4 (Rp 27.900.000 ✓); Asset detail: partial sell 5 lot BBCA @ 10000 → realized +Rp 500.000, remaining qty 5 lot, toast 'Terjual Rp 5.000.000 masuk ke Kas IDR' ✓; Sell MAX → zero-qty sheet appears with Sembunyikan/Hapus/Biarkan options ✓; Engine: rutin Rp 1.000.000 + Bagi Rata → Teralokasi 100% valid, Simpan button enabled, two-way %<>Rp sync visible ✓; Journal: ledger entries BELI/INIT/JUAL/DCA with filter chips working ✓; Playbook: theme toggle swaps dark↔light instantly ✓, PIN enable (1234) → status 'Aktif', 'Kunci Sekarang' shows [data-testid=lock-screen] ✓. No deprecated expo packages detected, no SafeAreaView issues.

issues: Minor console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - origins from an internal RN/Expo lib, non-blocking

Minor SVG warning on initial chart render: '<path> attribute d: Expected moveto path command' (empty snapshot series on first paint, auto-recovers after first snapshot) - cosmetic console warning only, no visible glitch

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Suppress or fix the SVG path warning in LineChart when series is empty on very first paint before any snapshot exists.
(Optional/cosmetic) Migrate pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents where used in internal components (if any) to silence the deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: store.tsx withSnapshot runs on every setState call which writes a snapshot even on trivial updates — could grow snapshots quickly; sliced to last 1000 so OK, but consider throttling to day boundary only.
LineChart emits an invalid SVG path on empty series — add a guard to render an empty state instead of malformed path.
All interactive elements have testIDs — good coverage. Mobile touch targets look >=44px for primary buttons.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created on backend. Test flow repeatedly clears localStorage and runs the Setup Wizard with: name=Tester, usdRate=15500 (default), cashIDR=5.000.000, BBCA (id_stocks) qty=10 avg=9000 current=9800. Then adds QQQ (usd_stocks) qty=2 avg=400 current=450.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is an offline-only Expo React Native app served via web preview; there is NO backend. All state in localStorage key 'pios_state_v1'. Testing is 100% UI via Playwright. Device clock during test = Oct 2026 so BTC phase shows 'ZONA AKUMULASI AGRESIF / BEST DCA' and today < 25 so review-reminder-widget is NOT visible by default. Each browser automation call starts fresh — localStorage does NOT persist across separate automation sessions; must re-run Setup Wizard at the start of each session. Correct chart toggle testIDs are 'networth-mode-month' and 'networth-mode-year' (not -monthly/-yearly). To click BBCA in audit, iterate asset-row-* elements and match textContent since IDs are dynamic.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found blocking the requested test scenarios.
